FileSearch.note: Full cmdk composition in a sized h-72/w-96 bordered root: CommandInput with its Search affordance, two CommandGroups with headings, a CommandSeparator, icons and right-aligned CommandShortcut diff counts. First item shows the data-[selected=true] bg-hover row.

ActionMenu.note: Command-palette variant — Session and Git groups with ⌘ shortcut badges and a disabled CommandItem at 50% opacity. Varies meaningfully from FileSearch.

NoResults.note: Controlled input value that matches nothing, so CommandEmpty renders its py-8 centred muted message while the list stays mounted. The empty branch is the point of this cell and it renders.
